description: This file defines the AesGcm class, providing a polyfill implementation for AES-GCM encryption and decryption in PHP. It includes methods for encrypting and decrypting data, initializing cryptographic components, and utility methods for string operations.

classes.name: AesGcm
classes.description: A class providing a polyfill for AES-GCM encryption and decryption, supporting specific constraints such as 96-bit nonces and 128-bit auth tags, supporting key sizes of 128, 192, and 256 bits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for AesGcm class, initializes with an AES key, key size, and block size, validating inputs.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Static method to perform AES-GCM encryption, taking plaintext, nonce, key, associated data, and tag reference; returns ciphertext.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Static method to perform AES-GCM decryption, verifying the authentication tag; returns plaintext if successful.

methods.name: gmacInit
methods.description: Initializes GMAC with nonce and associated data, returning the length and GMAC object.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Utility method to determine the length of a string, using mb_strlen if available.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Utility method to extract a substring from a string, using mb_substr if available.
